correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive face enumeration yields 20,652 augmented faces; full Hasse acyclicity covers all 120,240 incidences; a matching with only nine critical five-cells and one critical six-cell has exact signed zero boundary computed independently twice. Hurewicz identifies the six-cell attaching class with the zero degree vector, proving the integral wedge. A second acyclic matching gives a primitive rank-one boundary, corroborating the result. All statements and counts replay from the embedded standalone verifier.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic Levi graph, and the first higher-independence complex is naturally motivated by studying the relaxation of ordinary graph independence. A nonpure nine-dimensional complex collapsing to precisely nine five-spheres and one six-sphere supplies a meaningful exact topological invariant beyond known ordinary independence and edge matching complex homotopies. The mixed dimension and complete attaching information are structurally informative.
